solutions.title: Timestamped map with eviction scan
solutions.strategy: Track value and latest access time per key, scanning all keys only when capacity eviction is required.

timeComplexity.explanation: get does a hash lookup and timestamp update. put is O(1) unless it must evict, where it scans up to n cached entries to find the oldest timestamp.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The map stores at most capacity entries, each with a value and timestamp.

solutions.title: Hash map plus recency order
solutions.strategy: Maintain keys in access order so reads and writes move a key to the most-recent position and eviction removes the oldest key.

timeComplexity.explanation: Hash lookup, recency movement, insertion, update, and oldest-key removal all use constant-time linked map operations.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The cache stores at most capacity key-value pairs and one recency node per entry.
